name: pairwise-tui
description: Terminal UI for pairwise and combinatorial test case generation with Microsoft PICT
author: Radek Bednarik

scripts.build:dist: bun run build:dist:linux && bun run build:dist:windows
scripts.stats:releases: gh api repos/radekBednarik/pairwise-tui/releases --jq '[.[] | {tag: .tag_name, name: .name, totalDownloads: ([.assets[].download_count] | add // 0), assets: [.assets[] | {name: .name, downloads: .download_count}]}]'
scripts.stats:summary: printf 'Release downloads total: '; gh api repos/radekBednarik/pairwise-tui/releases --jq '[.[].assets[].download_count] | add // 0' && printf 'Repo views (14d): '; gh api repos/radekBednarik/pairwise-tui/traffic/views --jq '.count' && printf 'Unique repo visitors (14d): '; gh api repos/radekBednarik/pairwise-tui/traffic/views --jq '.uniques'
